name: realstitch
description: Branded 9:16 reel builder for talking-head footage: forced alignment, chroma key, pause removal, word-highlighted captions, storyboard graphics and b-roll. Ships /realstitch:init to scaffold a project, a frames-first /realstitch:reel command, a reel-reviewer agent, a safe-zone Stop hook, and a question sticker drawn from the storyboard rather than baked into a bitmap.
